failureMessage: getVoices() is empty until the browser has loaded voices, so a module-scope cache stays empty for the page's life and every utterance silently falls back to the OS default voice

matchLines.what: caches getVoices() at module scope, which runs before the browser has any voices to give
matchLines.fix: resolve the voice inside speak() and never keep an empty result — fall back for that utterance and resolve again on the next
